weeklyWindow: ALL_DAY (24/5) tickers are open Sunday 20:00 to Friday 20:00 America/New_York local time, following US daylight saving time. Encodable rule: for each NYSE trading day D the session is the half-open interval [20:00 local on the calendar day before D, 20:00 local on D), or ending 17:00 local when D is an early-close day. Point form: if local time >= 20:00, open iff the next calendar day is a trading day; else open iff today is a trading day and time < 20:00 (17:00 on early-close days). The owner's statement is confirmed. Chainlink Data Streams market hours: '24/5 US Equities and ETFs | 20:00 Sun | 20:00 Fri | None | NYSE holiday calendar'. Its marketStatus 5 Closed is '~8:00pm Fri–8:00pm Sun ET', and times 'follow US daylight saving time'. Chainlink's tokenized equity page has 'Weekend | Fri 20:00 – Sun 20:00'. Chainlink's feed metadata (reference-data-directory feeds-robinhood-mainnet.json) gives marketHours us_equities_24/5, heartbeat 86400 and threshold 0.5 for the SPY, QQQ, NVDA and AAPL feeds. Robinhood's broker says 'Robinhood 24 Hour Market is available from Sunday 8 PM ET through Friday 8 PM ET.' Robinhood's chain docs give no clock hours for the reference ('Stock feeds update 24/5, following market hours.'). Their only clock times are the mint and burn window 'Monday 02:00 CET/CEST – Saturday 02:00 CET/CEST', which is for market makers and is not the reference. Onchain check: all 2,414 rounds of the four launch feeds since 2026-06-21 fall inside the modeled sessions, and at each of the 15 opens every feed posted a round 18 to 69 s after 20:00.
dailyBreaks: None. Chainlink lists 'Daily breaks: None' for 24/5 US equities. Its sub-sessions meet at 04:00, 09:30, 16:00 and 20:00 ET: pre-market 04:00-09:30, regular 09:30-16:00, post-market 16:00-20:00, overnight 20:00-04:00. Robinhood describes the 24 Hour Market as one continuous market. The only maintenance Chainlink mentions happens while the market is closed ('When the market is closed, data providers may perform maintenance...'). The Robinhood Chain notices page lists no market-hours maintenance. Onchain, the feeds post rounds on Monday to Thursday nights between 20:00 and 04:00 (SPY 25, QQQ 79, NVDA 127, AAPL 41 rounds), and NVDA, QQQ and AAPL have rounds in all 24 New York hours.

holidayBehavior: The overnight session that starts at 20:00 ET belongs to the next day's trading. A holiday H therefore removes [20:00 on H-1, 20:00 on H). Robinhood: 'Orders entered for the 24 Hour Market generally could be executed 12 AM-8 PM ET on a full trading day (meaning Monday-Friday except for stock market holidays and half-days), 12 AM-5 PM ET on a stock market half-day, and 8 PM-12 AM ET on the day before either a full trading day or a stock market half-day.' Blue Ocean ATS operates 'only on those calendar days when the NYSE Trade Report Facility (TRF) is open for reporting the following morning' and publishes its closed evenings for 2025 to 2027 (Sunday 18 Jan 2026, Thursday 2 Apr 2026, Wednesday 25 Nov 2026 and so on). R2 closes exactly the 19 Sunday to Thursday evenings Blue Ocean lists for 2026 and 2027. Chainlink only says marketStatus 5 covers 'weekends, public holidays, and unexpected market closures', that the feeds publish no updates including heartbeats while closed, and that integrators should 'Incorporate authoritative exchange holiday calendars'. MONDAY holiday, e.g. MLK Mon 19 Jan 2026: the prior week closes Fri 16 Jan 20:00 EST (1768611600), Sunday evening stays closed, and the market reopens Mon 19 Jan 20:00 EST (1768870800, 2026-01-20T01:00:00Z), 72 h. Seen onchain for Labor Day 2026: no rounds Sunday 6 Sep, and all four feeds posted 31 to 54 s after Mon 7 Sep 20:00 EDT (1788825600). FRIDAY holiday, e.g. Good Friday 3 Apr 2026: closes Thu 2 Apr 20:00 EDT (1775174400, 2026-04-03T00:00:00Z) and reopens Sun 5 Apr 20:00 EDT (1775433600). Seen onchain for 3 Jul 2026: closed Thu 2 Jul 20:00 EDT and reopened Sun 5 Jul 20:00 EDT, with rounds 18 to 42 s later. MIDWEEK holiday, e.g. Thanksgiving Thu 26 Nov 2026: closes Wed 25 Nov 20:00 EST (1795654800, 2026-11-26T01:00:00Z) and reopens Thu 26 Nov 20:00 EST (1795741200, 2026-11-27T01:00:00Z), 24 h, for the Friday half-day. 1 Jan 2026 and 25 Nov 2027 have the same shape, and neither has been observed onchain yet. All 2,414 feed rounds since launch fall inside the model, and every one of 15 opens got a round from every feed within 18 to 69 s, so a missing round at a modeled-closed open is strong evidence.
earlyCloseBehavior: The ALL_DAY session ends at 17:00 ET on an early-close day. The regular session ends at 13:00 ET. Sources: Robinhood '12 AM-5 PM ET on a stock market half-day' and 'Stock market trading will close at 1 PM ET (with extended-hours trading concluding at 5 PM ET)', and NYSE 'NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m.'. Chainlink's current docs say nothing about US-equity half-days. An earlier version (commit c8a4097, removed 1 Jul 2026) said only 'Half-day trading may apply on the eve of certain U.S. holidays ... consult the linked exchange calendars'. The overnight session after an early close runs only if the next calendar day is a trading day. In 2026 and 2027 it never is: Fri 27 Nov 2026 and Fri 26 Nov 2027 are followed by weekends, and Thu 24 Dec 2026 by Christmas, which Blue Ocean lists as a closed Thursday evening. The evening before each early close does open, because a half-day counts as a trading day: Thu 26 Nov 2026 20:00 EST, Wed 23 Dec 2026 20:00 EST and Thu 25 Nov 2027 20:00 EST. No early close has happened since the feeds launched on 21 Jun 2026, so the 17:00 end is unverified onchain until 27 Nov 2026 (see open questions).

sessionTypeEnum: NONE: the default and unset value. Never open. Use when market.whole is not TRADABLE, tradingCapabilities is missing, or the only Chainlink feed is a DEX-state price (like GLD). Must never default to open.

ALL_DAY: tradingCapabilities.overnight.whole == TRADING_STATUS_TRADABLE, the documented equivalent of allDayTradability 'tradable'. Open per the 24/5 rule [20:00 on D-1, 20:00 on D) ET, 17:00 on early closes. Used by all 194 assets today, including SPY, QQQ, NVDA and AAPL.

REGULAR: market.whole TRADABLE only, or overnight capability lost (untradable, position_closing_only, empty or null). Open on trading days 09:30-16:00 ET, 13:00 on early closes. Implied by the schema, unused today. This is the safe fallback type.

EXTENDED: extended.whole TRADABLE and overnight not. Implied by the live schema but its start is unsettled (Chainlink pre-market 04:00, Robinhood broker 07:00), with a 20:00 end (17:00 on early closes). Unused today. Recommended: do not encode it.
openQuestions: Q1 Field name: PRD 7.4 names the issuer's allDayTradability field, but the live /rhj/assets response has none. Default: read tradingCapabilities.overnight.whole and treat TRADING_STATUS_TRADABLE as ALL_DAY. Why: the documented meaning of allDayTradability ('RH all-day / overnight (24/5) trading flag') is the overnight slot of the live shape, and the live API is what the keeper sees. The owner must confirm because it changes a PRD field name.

Q2 Which types to carry: Default NONE (unset, never open) plus ALL_DAY, with REGULAR only if a later ticker needs it, and no EXTENDED. Why: every asset and every Robinhood equity feed is 24/5 today, and EXTENDED hours are unsettled (04:00 vs 07:00). Also, a ticker whose only feed is a DEX-state price (GLD) should be NONE and not a rule target, which TokenSource should enforce.

Q3 Early-close end for ALL_DAY: Default 17:00 ET. Why: Robinhood's 24 Hour Market (12 AM-5 PM on half-days) and NYSE's late sessions (close 5:00 p.m.) agree, and Chainlink is silent. Unverified onchain until 27 Nov 2026. Check the feed rounds that day between 13:00 and 20:00 ET and adjust before 24 Dec 2026. Either error costs little: up to 4 h of a stale-but-capped reference, or 4 h of queueing.

Q4 Boundaries and the first minute after an open: Default half-open [open, close). Also have the library expose the current session's opening instant so PriceGuard can require feed updatedAt >= that instant. Why: the first post-open round lands 18-69 s after the open. After the three 24 h midweek closures (1 Jan 2026, 26 Nov 2026, 25 Nov 2027) the 25 h age limit does not catch the pre-close round if it came under 1 h before the close; QQQ's last round came 897 s before the 17 Jul close. This touches PriceGuard and the PRD check order, so the owner decides.

Q5 DST law: H.R. 139 (Sunshine Protection Act) passed the House 14 Jul 2026 (308-117) and was referred to Senate Commerce on 15 Jul 2026. It has no delayed effective date and would keep New York at UTC-4. Default: encode current law, and make the timelocked path able to replace future switch entries, not only append. Why: a law change with under 48 h notice would put every boundary one hour off in UTC.

Q6 Unscheduled closures (national days of mourning, for example 5 Dec 2018 and 9 Jan 2025 in exchange_calendars), halts and corporate-action pauses: Default: the timelocked path can add a full-day closure or early close. Shorter-notice events rely on PriceGuard's age, oraclePaused and premium checks. Record this in DECISIONS.md.

Q7 Mint and burn window 'Monday 02:00 CET/CEST – Saturday 02:00 CET/CEST': Default: ignore it and follow New York time only. It is for market makers, and end users trade outside it. In the US/EU clock-mismatch weeks (starting Sun 8, 15 and 22 Mar 2026, 25 Oct 2026, 14 and 21 Mar 2027, and 31 Oct 2027) it runs from Sunday 21:00 to Friday 21:00 ET.

Q8 Coverage edges: Default: revert with a named custom error for t < 1767243600 (2026-01-01T05:00:00Z) or t >= 1830315600 (2028-01-01T05:00:00Z), and expose the coverage end so the module can queue with a reason instead of reverting. Why: the build contract forbids silent fallback. The 2028 NYSE holidays are already published, so the extension can be queued well before Dec 2027.

Q9 Authority for the window: docs.robinhood.com/chain never states Sunday 20:00 to Friday 20:00. It comes from Chainlink's market-hours page, Chainlink's feed metadata and Robinhood's broker page. Default: cite those in DECISIONS.md.
